draw: 2025 nonresident whitetail either-sex deer draw (first application period)
choice_basis: Rows are [preference points, applicants (not published per point level), permits issued at that point level]. apps_1st_choice is total first-choice applicants for the unit (all point levels). Permits issued include group-draw overage.

sources.label: KDWP Limited Draw Statistics Report 2025 - Nonresident Whitetail Either Sex Deer, First Application Period (PDF)

notes: KDWP publishes permits issued by preference point level and total applicants by choice, not applicants per point level, so applicants are null in point rows.
Permits are by unit; the equipment type (archery, muzzleloader, any season) is chosen on the application but the statistics are reported per unit.
48,459 total applications in 2025: 33,962 permit applications, 14,497 points-only.
Every unit's point-level permits sum exactly to quota + group overage (checked all 18 units).

The agency publishes how many winners had each point count, not applicants at each level. Everyone above the lowest winning level is assumed to have drawn, and all remaining applicants are counted at that lowest level.
